Method of Attack: Buffer overrun in X.509 certificate verification during name constraint checking
Crafting a malicious email address to overflow bytes on the stack
Impacted Systems: TLS clients connecting to malicious servers
TLS servers requesting client authentication with malicious clients
Linux distributions with vulnerable stack layouts
Attack Vector: Malicious certificates signed by a CA
Applications continuing certificate verification despite failure to construct a path to a trusted issuer
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious email addresses in certificates containing the '.' character (decimal 46)
Four attacker-controlled bytes on the stack
